# Vendor material boundary

`docs/goose/` is a large imported upstream documentation tree. It is retained for source comparison and provenance. It must not appear as Custos product documentation, implementation status or an approved dependency merely because it is present in this repository.

Before relocating or removing any vendor file, record upstream repository and commit, local import date, license/notice, content hash, Custos call path using it, and inbound links. A later cleanup may move the tree under this namespace after an audit; this page does not authorize deletion.
